DSLITE
Description
DS-lite is an IPv6 transition mechanism which addresses operators who
want IPv6-only access networks while providing support for IPv4-only
nodes.
Command List
DSLITE::remote_addr
- Returns the
remote DS-Lite tunnel endpoint IP address.
